eps.t: ‘The Strangers: Chapter 2’ and ‘Gabby’s Dollhouse: The Movie’
eps.o: In Season 16 Ep 1, the pre-eminent Movie Buff Gregg Turkington and Host New Heidecker christen a new filming location and catch us up on their end of Summer exploits. Plus, a familiar brand has caught Heidecker's interest once again and a controversial VFA business decision is unveiled...

Season 16 Ep 2 gets right into it with two, maybe three, and possibly even four movie reviews. Where else can you find this hard-hitting cinema criticism? Oh, and a friend of the show stops by to give an update on how On Cinema at the Cinema has impacted his livelihood.

Halloween Season is getting started. How do these new spook-fests stack up with the classics? Plus, big things are afoot with father G Amato's estate and a brand-new advance in movie sorting technology has arrived from the VFA Labs... Watch a demonstration and then head to vfa.expert to bring it to your home.

eps.t: ‘Springsteen: Deliver Me from Nowhere’, ‘Regretting You’, and ‘The Watchers’
eps.o: Host New Heidecker and returning guest Expert Gregg Turkington do something a little different on this latest episode of On Cinema at the Cinema as a tip of the hat to Old Hollywood... Plus, a rare third movie review and a big announcement about what is in store for On Cinema's future.

A new chapter in On Cinema history has arrived! Welcome Host New Heidecker and Guest Expert Gregg Turkington to The Manor, a nurturing and enriching space dedicated to the unique needs and desires of older adults. Remember, you can never be too old to be a buff! Plus, the much-awaited reviews of ‘Bugonia’ and ‘Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc’. Five bags? We will see...

Things are heating up at On Cinema at the Cinema at the Manor! A special guest joins Host New Heidecker and Expert Gregg Turkington, we get a look at some of the rocking times happening behind the scenes, and, of course, we find out what to watch this weekend!

eps.t: 'Now You See Me: Now You Don't' and 'Jay Kelly'
eps.o: It's Movie Time at the Manor... And what pairs best with movies? Arts and crafts! Join your On Cinema favs and the good folks at the Grand Terrace At The Manor for another episode of expertise you can trust. Plus, an update on New Heidecker's organ age.
After some difficult news, Magic Mark Pork arrives at the Manor with a new act to spread some cheer. Plus a return to Oz with this week's review of Wicked: For Good.

eps.t: Celebrating the Life of Gabriel “G” Amato
eps.o: Friends and family gather at the Crown-Wynne Funeral Home to remember the life of a great man taken from us far too soon.

We are all still reeling from the passing of New Heidecker's father, G Amato, yet the show must go on! Our Host and Guest Expert Buff find themselves dealing with the aftermath of the Funeral and a big announcement is unveiled in this Season finale.
